sanjay: Quick sync request — we need a cross-team plan to ship a reliability dashboard that codifies an error taxonomy (timeouts, 5xx, OOM, degraded/fallback counts) and the telemetry primitives runtime/infra should emit. Looking for concrete metric names, tagset, sample queries, and a quick UX ask for the Console (rollout + filterability).

lucy: SG. Obs already has some per-route 5xx/timeouts but the panels are inconsistent. We should standardize tag names: model, route, deployment, variant, tenant, fallback_reason. Can runtime emit a `fallbacks_count_total` counter with those tags? :thinking_face:

mike: Runtime can emit counters but need exact tagset. Also prefer counters for error rates and histograms for latency. OOMs today are logged as exit events; we can increment an `oom_events_total` counter from the agent on crash. Need agreement on names and cardinality.

kevin: eng-sre chiming in — SLI-friendly names please, e.g. `errors_5xx_total`, `errors_timeout_total`, `errors_oom_total`, `fallbacks_count_total`. Add a common `outcome` label: `outcome=ok|degraded|fallback`. Also we need `quota_bucket` or `plan` label so we can correlate errors with quota throttling.

anna: product side — rollout UX needs a top-level "failure percent" metric on the Console page, plus canary alerts tied to the same queries. Product wants to surface fallback rate per model and allow filtering by rollout id.

lucy: Sample PromQL snippets to start the dashboard panels:
```promql
sum(rate(errors_timeout_total[5m])) by (model, route)
sum(rate(errors_5xx_total[5m])) by (route)
sum(rate(fallbacks_count_total[5m])) by (model, fallback_reason)
```

mike: Small additions from runtime: include `fallback_mode` label (`auto|manual`) and `variant` (quantized, fp16, etc). For latency we export `request_latency_seconds_bucket` histogram. Also suggest adding `request_seq_len` histogram for perf drilldowns.

sanjay: To lock this down — proposed canonical tagset: `model`, `route`, `deployment`, `variant`, `tenant`, `fallback_reason`, `fallback_mode`, `outcome`, `rollout_id`. Proposed metric names: `errors_5xx_total`, `errors_timeout_total`, `oom_events_total`, `fallbacks_count_total`, `request_latency_seconds_bucket`. Runtime to emit counters/histograms with that tagset. Infra to ensure OOM log attachments (last 10 lines) are available in the event payload.

kevin: Alerting suggestions: fallback_rate > 2% sustained over 10m for high-traffic routes; 5xx_rate > 1% over 5m triggers paging for SLO-bound services. We'll tune thresholds per-customer-tier. Also request a dedicated dashboard panel that shows "degraded-mode events" per rollout id for rollback decisions.

anna: UX asks: sparkline + current value, filter by rollout_id, quick link to rollout details, and ability to pin a failing promptset or test to the dashboard. Also add a compact table: top 5 routes by fallback rate.

lucy: I'll mock up dashboard panels and export a grafana JSON blob with recommended queries. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

mike: Runtime will add instrumentation PR by Friday. We'll include tests that assert metric labels exist.

sanjay: Owners for telemetry schema: @lucy (obs), @mike (runtime), @kevin (sre). Thanks everyone — once Lucy posts the panel JSON we'll review and add Console wiring for rollout filters. :thumbsup:
